citations.quote: Annie generates a stack of Pyromania whenever she hits an enemy with Disintegrate or casts her other abilities, stacking up to 4 times

advanced_exceptions.summary: Q generates a stack on hitting an enemy; her other abilities generate stacks on casting. The general four-spell description does not establish that an unlanded Q generates a stack.

citations.quote: Energized: Annie empowers her next cast of Disintegrate, Incinerate, or Summon: Tibbers to consume all Pyromania stacks to stun enemies hit
The stun applies to the first ability that lands when the stun is available.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Q, W and R can deliver the stun, consuming all stacks. The first eligible ability to land delivers it, so cast order alone does not determine which ability stuns.

citations.quote: Stacks are gained even if the ability is blocked by spell shield.
Annie does not lose any stacks upon entering or exiting resurrection.
She will lose Energized and all Pyromania stacks upon death.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Spell shields do not prevent stack generation. Resurrection transitions preserve stacks; death clears them, with full stacks granted upon respawning.

citations.quote: After casting 4 spells, Annie's next offensive spell will stun the target.
At maximum stacks, her next offensive spell will consume them to stun the target.

core_mechanics.summary: Build four Pyromania stacks to empower an offensive spell to stun enemies hit.

citations.quote: Annie begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available.
Annie gains maximum stacks of Pyromania when the game starts and upon respawning.

core_mechanics.summary: The stun is ready at game start and after respawning.

unsupported_claims: Every Q cast generates a stack even if it never hits an enemy.
E can deliver the empowered stun.
Every spell cast while the stun is ready will stun independently.

citations.quote: Disintegrate will also grant the cooldown reduction and mana cost refund if the target is dead upon the missile's arrival.

advanced_exceptions.summary: The refund and cooldown reduction also occur if the target is already dead when the missile arrives.

citations.quote: If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).

advanced_exceptions.summary: Listed target-invalidating events during the cast time cancel Q without spending mana or starting its cooldown.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Retaliation is limited to once per enemy per cast for each active shield.

While Molten Shield is active, enemies that deal damage to it take magic damage.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Retaliation includes damaging spells as well as attacks. The Wiki's shorter basic-attack description is narrower than Riot and the Wiki's detailed description.

citations.quote: Molten Shield does not deal damage to turrets when attacked by them.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Turrets do not receive retaliation. Dodged or missed attacks do not trigger it, but blocked attacks do. The Wiki reports non-triggering interactions with Noxious Trap and Jack in the Box as bugs.
